r.s: Class for parsing and handling URL.
r.d: Provides parsing of URLs into their constituent parts (scheme, host, path etc.), URL generation, and resolving of relative URLs.
r.n: * Fixed #20156: setAuthority() flaw with "0" as host * Fixed #20157: normalize() flaw with "0" as path * Fixed #20158: Fragment-only references are not resolved to non-absolute base URI * Fixed #20159: Authority not terminated by slash * Fixed diverse coding style violations and misc. minor issues * Increased code coverage * Added support for Scrutinizer CI
